# Review of 9204298: dispositions

The independent incremental review of the zip `9204298` (27 October 2026) compares that zip with the one at `2d696e6`. Its text is beside this file (`2026-10-27-review-9204298.md`). Øystein brought it to the lead session on 28 October, where every claim it makes about the code was checked against `main` at 9204298.

Its verdict: round 45 is a real but local gain. The loop from event to feeling to meeting to decision is the advance; whole lives and play are not shown to be better. That matches round 45's own outcome in BOARD and needs no disposition.

Its own runs agree with ours. With `OFF=feelings` the world is identical to `2d696e6` in three short worlds, and a world replays the same with feelings on.

## Findings

| Finding                                                                                                                           | Holds in the code?                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | Disposition                                                                                                                                                                                                         | Slot                                                                   |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1. A weaker wrong renews an older feeling but keeps the old cause (`ev`, `what`, `t`)                                             | Yes (`feel()`, `src/feelings.ts:80`). Worse than the review says: a resentment that was let go stands again with its old `t`. If that is 36 months back, `lasting()` (`:287`) adds "never forgave" next month, citing the settled wrong. That changes acts, not only words. It is rare today: 2 such reopenings in 22 throwaway worlds (9001–9022) over 30 past and 10 present years, none leading to a mark. | Taken. A renewal that makes a let-go feeling stand again takes the new cause, its words and its month. Taking sides makes renewals common, so the fix belongs to that round.                                        | Round 46, behind its switch; its sizing counts renewals and reopenings |
| 2. A meeting needs no place: friends, kin or a circle are enough, and `place` is then undefined                                   | Yes (`shares()`, `src/situations/meeting.ts:10`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | Taken in part. A month-scale meeting stays shared ground, not a location. The front door says so: a meeting with no `place` was arranged, and a game that stages it is depicting it, not reading where it happened. | S2, the front door's part two; announced on #60                        |
| 3. The world signature leaves out `event.explain` and each person's event index                                                   | Yes (`src/tools/diag/signature.ts:40`, `:44`), as designed: a `words` change may alter explanations. But a `refactor`, which claims everything is identical, is checked by the same signature, so it could change an explanation unseen.                                                                                                                                                                      | Taken. A `refactor` is also checked with explanations and event indexes in the hash. A `words` change keeps the narrower check.                                                                                     | N7, the identity sees explanations                                     |
| 4. The front door's open obligations from the review of `2d696e6` (handle, viewer scope, authority, validation, hearsay citation) | Yes, unchanged                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | Already slotted                                                                                                                                                                                                     | S2, N5, N6                                                             |
| 5. The gate shows feelings get more chances to act, not that people's answers are credible                                        | Yes, as a reading of the evidence                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | Taken. That is what the played tests are for, and why round 45 was not counted as reading better.                                                                                                                   | S1, people play the slice                                              |
